changes.oldText: Select the Model Folder to download into. As the helper text under the field notes, only model folders in the current project that you can mount with write permission are listed — the download session writes into the folder, so folders you can only mount read-only are excluded. The buttons next to the selector let you open the selected folder, create a new model folder, and refresh the list. When creating a new folder here, set its mount permission to read & write: a folder created with read-only mount permission cannot receive the download, and a warning tells you to create one with read & write mount permission instead.
changes.newText: Select the Model Folder to download into. As the helper text under the field notes, only model folders in the current project that you can mount with write permission are listed — the download session writes into the folder, so folders you can only mount read-only are excluded. The buttons next to the selector let you open the selected folder, create a new model folder, and refresh the list. A folder created from this dialog is read-only, so it cannot receive the download: change its Default mount permission to Read & Write from the folder's Share Folder modal (Folder Info → Edit) before selecting it here.
